summary: Mean-reverting (Ornstein–Uhlenbeck) process: deviations from the long-run mean μ shrink at rate κ; volatility σ sets the noise. Half-life of deviations ≈ ln(2)/κ.

ranges.phrase: Slow reversion — the series wanders far from the mean for long stretches.
Moderate reversion — half-life is short relative to the observed window.
Fast reversion — the series stays tightly clustered around the mean.
